SASBDB entry SASDHT9  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDHT9/)

Publication: Mechanism of NanR gene repression and allosteric induction of bacterial sialic acid metabolism.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1101/2020.04.22.056440  (bioRxiv preprint, 2020 Apr 24)

No publication PDF is kept in this folder. The fitting script
test/fitting_tests/SASDHT9/ takes the buffer and sample conditions from the SASBDB entry
metadata (experiment description), which it quotes.
